# CODERZWEB

> High-performance web development, custom Next.js web application engineering, e-commerce architectures, and performance marketing agency based in Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu, serving businesses across South India and pan-India.

CODERZWEB builds enterprise-grade digital systems engineered for speed, search dominance, and measurable revenue growth. We combine modern front-end web architecture (Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS) with data-driven performance marketing (Meta Ads, Google Ads) and AI-powered CRM automation (Official WhatsApp Business API).

## Geographic Service Hubs
CODERZWEB provides on-site consultations and remote digital engineering across:
- **Krishnagiri**: Primary headquarters, serving granite exporters, agro-businesses, schools, and local retail.
- **Hosur**: Primary B2B growth market, building product catalogs and lead engines for manufacturing units in SIPCOT I & II and auto-component suppliers.
- **Bangalore (Bengaluru)**: Serving tech startups, D2C brands, and corporate enterprises along the Electronic City and South Bangalore corridor with high-performance Next.js engineering at cost-effective rates.
- **Dharmapuri**: Digital solutions for medical, education, agro-processing, and commercial enterprises.
- **Tirupattur**: Web development and e-commerce platforms for leather manufacturers, export traders, and retail businesses.
- **Bargur & Shoolagiri**: Web design and marketing for educational institutions, warehousing, and highway retail logistics.
- **Pan-India**: Remote software and web app engineering for clients in Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, and Hyderabad.

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. Custom Website & Web Application Development
- Engineering lightning-fast websites using modern tech stacks: Next.js (App Router), React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, and Node.js.
- Single-page landing architectures, corporate websites, dynamic portals, and Progressive Web Apps (PWAs) with iOS and Android sync.
- 40% faster loading speeds and 100/100 Core Web Vitals optimization compared to legacy WordPress templates.

### 2. E-Commerce Solutions
- Full-stack custom online stores with mobile-first UI/UX.
- Integrated domestic and international payment gateways: Razorpay, UPI, Cashfree, Stripe, Credit/Debit cards.
- Automated inventory synchronization, abandoned cart recovery, and direct WhatsApp order notifications.

### 3. Performance Marketing (Meta & Google Ads)
- ROI-driven lead generation campaigns on Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Search / Display.
- Localized audience targeting for retail showrooms, service providers, and B2B industrial suppliers.

### 4. Official WhatsApp Business API Automation
- Verified WhatsApp Business API setup for automated instant inquiries, bulk broadcasts, and CRM integration.
- Automated customer follow-ups, lead qualification bots, and order status alerts.

### 5. UI/UX, Logo Design & Branding
- Custom brand identity creation, responsive vector logos, brand color systems, and modern design guidelines.

### 6. Promotional Video Production & Ad Creatives
- High-converting short-form video production, Instagram Reels, promotional commercial videos, and social media creative assets.
